rooms.name: Vistani Tent
rooms.desc: A great tent lit from within, smoke pouring from its peak; three sputtering fires, Vistani sprawled drunk, a bound boy at the pole and a man with a whip.
rooms.dm: Arrigal whips the sentry who lost Arabelle; Luvash is drunk and dangerous.

rooms.name: The Hilltop
rooms.desc: A hill above the fog ringed by barrel-topped wagons.

rooms.name: Kasimir's Hovel
rooms.desc: A hovel with a decorated vestibule and a snug room with a fire.
rooms.dm: Kasimir tells of the Amber Temple to anyone bent on destroying Strahd.

rooms.name: Vestibule
rooms.desc: A painted vestibule; three cowled, angular figures stand before it.

rooms.name: Dusk Elf Hovel
rooms.desc: A simple house at the base of the hill; a grey-cloaked figure at its door.
rooms.dm: Dusk elves; they send visitors to Kasimir.
